text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
What a haul, what a haul! To scoop up this much,
you're pretty good! That's the Boss for ya!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
What a haul, what a haul! To scoop up this much,
you're pretty good! That's Big Sis for ya!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heheh! Every single one of 'em's
got such a cute face! Totally won me over!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
From today on, you guys are my family!
I'm counting on ya!
